answer_1.quote: Data-to-text generation aims to produce humanunderstandable text from semi-structured data such as tables, concepts, etc.
models: Proposed neural network based encoder-decoder model with structural encoding
answer_1.outputs: Generated text descriptions from structured input data.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated text, we use three popular metrics-BLEU, ROUGE and METEOR... We also use a recent data-to-text generation evaluation metric, PARENT.

answer_4.quote: In human-based evaluation for annotations purpose, we select four university graduate students from various majors.
answer_4.guideline: For adequacy and readability, every annotator is asked to rate each text on a scale of 1 to 5.
